thread:
Alex K: Heads-up team — need to finalize webinar concept and run-of-show by EOD Monday. Goal: practical playbook for shipping cost-conscious LLM demos.
Olivia: cool. thinking 'Live routing & fallback playbook' with a short benchmark demo. keeps it tactical.
Maria: agree, less theory more config + checklist. can we show a live failover and traffic split?
Samir: I can demo quant/profile swaps and the perf delta. will bring a simple script.
Jordan: customer could speak to ops changes and cost savings. I'll confirm with them today.
Alex K: Olivia, can you write a 1-line invite plus 3 bullets for the landing page? marketing needs it for Tuesday.
Olivia: draft invite: "Hands-on tactics for routing models, graceful fallbacks, and lowering inference unit costs. Includes a live bench and implementation checklist." bullets: 1) routing policies that prevent latency spikes 2) demo of quantization vs throughput 3) ops checklist for safe rollouts
Maria: small edits: "prevent" -> "avoid" latency spikes, and add "monitoring hooks" to bullet 3.
Olivia: updated.
Samir: proposed run-of-show (50m): 5m intros, 12m routing policies & decision matrix, 20m live bench + failover (reserve 3m hotfix), 10m customer talk, 3-5m live Q. finish w/ 1-slide action checklist.
Alex K: add TL;DR slide at the top and 1-pager post-webinar summary.
Jordan: rehearsal windows: Wed 9:30-10:30 PT or Thu 2-3pm PT. prefer Wed.
Maria: ops runbook for demo: 1) pre-warm dedicated pool 2) snapshot KV cache 3) enable fallback variant 4) start traffic harness 5) monitor token throughput & p95 latency
Maria: traffic harness snippet:
```bash
# quick k6 stub for demo traffic
k6 run --vus 60 --duration 4m demo-script.js
```
Samir: add throttling guard: route internal demo accounts to dedicated, apply token-level quotas on hosted tier during demo window.
Olivia: marketing needs 3 tweet-length lines for promo and short speaker bios (<=100 words) by Monday COB.
Alex K: assignments: Olivia - invite + promo bullets + landing draft; Jordan - customer bio + anonymized numbers; Samir - infra/quant slide + demo script; Maria - ops checklist + runbook; Alex - verify greenroom + failover triggers.
Jordan: I'll anonymize the customer's numbers (cost down ~22% on peak) and send bio.
stage-bot: rehearsal room reserved Wed 09:30-10:30 PT (zoom.redwood.io/greenroom).
Alex K: question: do we want a 1-page pre-read for registrants with key metrics to bring? good for the hands-on crowd.
Maria: yes, I'll draft a "prep for the bench" one-pager with sample logs and metrics to inspect.
Olivia: once I have bullets I'll spin the landing page in draft and tag for review. aiming to open regs Tue AM.
Alex K: final: quick standup Wed 09:15 PT to confirm greenroom + run traffic once. thanks all :rocket:
